title: 2. Analyzing Large Codebases
content: ## What is Apache Superset? A OSS modern data exploration and visualization platform. It is a BI platform that: - Connects to data sources - Enables data engineers to create dashboards from these sources - Make those dashboards available to technical and non-technical users Superset is a **monorepo** (all related modules are stored here). The backend is a Flask server designed as a *Layered Architecture Style*. ### Layered Architecture Style The idea is that we can separate the code by its overall theme. Model View Controller (**MVC**) is an example. ### Microkernel Architecture Style Superset uses this architecture to connect to arbitrary data sources. This also called **plug-in architecture.** A small, stable core provides the fundamental execution/coordination mechanism, while most functionality lives in independently developed plug-ins/extensions. - The core system is **NOT** dependent on a specific plugin to work - Plugins communicate to the core system using a defined contract
